spans.s:
(ऌ) सृपॢ r. 1st. cl. (सर्पति)
To go, to move.
With अप,
To go from, to depart.
With उप,
To go near.

mf. (-टः-टी)
A measure.
E.
सृ to go, पाट aff.

f. (-का)
The beak of a bird.
E.
सृ to go, पाट aff., कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Gone, going.
E.
सृप to go, क्त aff.

m. (-प्रः)
The moon.
E.
सृप to go, रक् Uṇādi aff.
